Groups are a porting tactic, not acceptance; the inventory is the existing parser plus the goldens. The four data-driven generation sites are parser.py:782, :847 (:846 builds the list), :950, :1024.

text|json = every command calling _add_output_format_argument (parser.py:906-912) plus runtime workers (parser.py:83-88); text|json|yaml = inbox (parser.py:551), message subcommands (parser.py:599), faq (parser.py:644). Fully derivable.
'runtime workers' is the concrete `runtime workers` subcommand: parser.py:78-87 adds --format choices=('text','json'). It is not a separate undocumented worker class.

Positionals are common: nargs='?'/'*'/'+' at parser.py:515,577-627,664,901,1104, plus required positionals (atoms doc_id, graph neighbors id, edit selector/field/value). Arg can hold them in flags as a bare name.

No argparse aliases (aliases=) or hidden commands (help=SUPPRESS) in parser.py. The only alias is `inbox`, a real deprecated command with its own help string (parser.py:495-552), so it has a golden.
